quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces September 2026 Production and Operations (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 operations update, AI Cloud key metrics as of 9/30/2026 vs August 2026: GPUs deployed 4,328 vs 4,328 (types H100, H200, B200, B300, GB200, GB300); utilization rate 95% vs 92%; GPUs under external subscription 4,007 vs 3,998; ARR ~$86M vs ~$86M; revenue backlog $2.9B vs $0.9B. CFO Michael G. Potter: 'September demonstrated our ability to convert owned power into contracted AI Cloud revenue'; he added that the Bitcoin mining business 'continues to benefit from increased tailwinds as pricing continues to strengthen.'
quarterly_data.figure: 4,328 GPUs; 95% utilization; 4,007 GPUs under external subscription; ARR ~$86M; revenue backlog $2.9B (August $0.9B)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces September 2026 Production and Operations (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI announced a collaboration with NVIDIA on the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, which combines NVIDIA OpenShell software controls and the NVIDIA Sentry reference system design; the collaboration focuses on infrastructure-level policy enforcement, sandboxing and auditability for enterprise AI agents, and Bitdeer plans to integrate NVIDIA's AI safety technology stack to strengthen software- and hardware-based protection for production-grade agentic workflows.

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces September 2026 Production and Operations (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitcoin mining, September 2026: mined 1,355 Bitcoins (August 1,310; September 2025 452), an increase of 200% year-over-year; self-mining hash rate 82.3 EH/s (August 79.9; September 2025 35.0); other proprietary hash rate 4.1 EH/s; total proprietary hash rate 86.4 EH/s (August 84.1); co-mining hash rate 28.7 EH/s (August 21.6), using Bitdeer's mining rigs operated by third-party datacenters; BTC held 47 (August 61; September 2025 2,029). Company: 'we continue to expect momentum in our mining results over the coming months.'
quarterly_data.figure: 1,355 BTC (+200% Y/Y); 82.3 EH/s self-mining; 28.7 EH/s co-mining; 47 BTC held
